_doc: VIEWSEED: the same Rect drag as draw_rect.json, run OFF the identity
view. draw_rect.json (and every other gesture vector) runs at zoom 1.0 /
offset (0, 0), where the screen->document conversion every tool applies —
`doc = (screen - view_offset) / zoom`, YamlTool's pointer_event_payload in
both ports — is algebraically the identity, so a tool that forgot to
convert would pass anyway. That is the whole of CORPUS_CENSUS.md §5.7, and
the reason the path-eraser, type-on-path and paintbrush coordinate-space
bugs were all found by hand in the live app instead of here.
The corpus event coordinates are VIEWPORT-LOCAL PIXELS (what the canvas
widget delivers), not document units — the runners hand them straight to
onPress / onMove / onRelease, exactly as the canvas does. rect.yaml commits
geometry from `event.doc_x` / `event.doc_y`, so at zoom 2 with the document
origin drawn at screen (-100, -50):
so the committed rect is x 120, y 70, w 100, h 100. A port that dropped the
conversion would commit x 140, y 90, w 200, h 200 — off by the offset in
position and by a factor of the zoom in size, which is exactly the failure
shape of all three historical bugs. The threshold guard in on_mouseup is in
SCREEN units (`abs(event.x - start_x) > 1`) and stays satisfied here: the
drag is 200 screen px.
setup_svg is the same circle_basic.svg draw_rect.json uses, so the two
vectors differ ONLY in the view they run at.
name: draw_rect_zoomed
